notes: An INNER JOIN never null-extends either side: a result row exists only where a matching pair exists, so `tweet.id` keeps its catalog NOT NULL. The join partner `products` is entirely nullable, which is the point -- a nullable column on the *other* side of an inner join must not contaminate this one. Paired with the LEFT/RIGHT/FULL variants harvested from the same sqlx test, this pins down that the nullability upgrade is driven by the join type and the side, not by the presence of a join at all.
